name: sol10-catalog-name-wrap
goal: Keep realistic component names inside the mobile catalog viewport

evidence: Current committed CatalogView catalog run f8b87a66 passes 14 cases and fails the long-name mobile case: document scrollWidth 533 exceeds viewport 390. The card title must wrap without clipping.

The existing component-catalog-previews long state used a descriptive phrase with spaces. Commit 7855771112 replaces it with a realistic unbroken code name while preserving all states and viewport assertions. The existing document-width assertion now detects the missing wrapping.
